objects: permanent with the ordinary current represented Hexproof keyword
timing: CR 608.2b target revalidation immediately before resolution
targets: an opponent's spell or ability cannot target the permanent
the permanent's current controller may target it
choices: the server exposes only currently legal public target references
hidden_information: this represented contract applies only to public battlefield permanents
layers: consume the current represented layer-6 keyword result; unsupported ability-changing producers fail trusted closure
copy: the current represented copied keyword state is consumed; unsupported copy and face-down producers fail trusted closure
control_change: legality is recomputed from the permanent's current controller at offer, submission, and resolution
zone_change: a new battlefield incarnation is re-evaluated from its current represented characteristics
source_leaves: resolution revalidation uses the pinned acting controller and current target characteristics

variants: Hexproof on players and Hexproof from qualities are outside this contract and remain explicit compiler residuals
